size.doc: Scales the part: its length, height and width together. Its length runs from the back of the head to the front.

crown.doc: How far its top rises above its socket, a fraction of the length.

width.doc: Its half width, a fraction of the length.

back.doc: How far it hangs below its socket at the back, a fraction of the length: about 0.5 to the nape on a round head.

sides.doc: How far its sides hang below its socket from the middle to the front, a fraction of the length: 0 to the ears, about 0.4 to the jaw.

fringe.doc: How far its middle hangs below its socket at the front, a fraction of the length: negative stops it above the socket's height, over the brow.

rise.doc: How far its rings' middles rise toward the front, a fraction of the length, so its front closes on the forehead.

flip.doc: How far its hem flares out, a share of its half width.

fullness.doc: How full it stays toward its front and back: 2 rounds it as an ellipse, higher squares it.

parting.doc: Where round its top its parting lies: 0 the middle, toward 0.25 its v 0.25 side, negative the other side.

partDepth.doc: How deep the parting dents its top, a share of its crown.

hemShade.doc: How far up from each ring's lowest point its hem area reaches, a fraction of the length.

partShade.doc: How wide its parting area is, a share of a turn.

shineAt.doc: The height of its band of shine on the sphere through its rings, -1 underneath to 1 at the crown.

shineWidth.doc: How wide its band of shine is, on the same sphere.

shineJag.doc: How deep the band's lower edge is cut into points.

shineTeeth.doc: How many points the band's lower edge is cut into round the crown; 0 for a smooth edge.

locks.doc: How many locks its hem parts into round the head, seen from above; 0 for a whole hem.

lockDepth.doc: How far up between two locks its hem is cut, a fraction of the length.

lockJag.doc: How much shorter some locks are than others, a share of the cut: a ragged, layered hem.

lockSkew.doc: How far each lock's point leans toward one neighbour, -1 to 1.

lockRound.doc: How round the locks' points are: 0 pointed, 1 round.

lockSeed.doc: Which locks are the shorter ones.

lockFlare.doc: How far each lock's point splays out sideways, a share of the half width.

sweep.doc: How far the fringe sweeps aside: longer toward the side v 0.25 faces when positive, toward the other when negative.

strands.doc: How many strand lines are inked flowing down over it from its crown.
